description: This file provides functions for sending and editing messages, polls, reactions, and read receipts in a Matrix chat environment. It includes text chunking, media handling, and message relation management.

classes.name: MatrixPreparedSingleText
classes.description: Type representing a prepared single chunk of text for Matrix message sending.

classes.name: MatrixPreparedChunkedText
classes.description: Type representing a chunked text prepared for Matrix message sending, extending MatrixPreparedSingleText with chunks.

classes.name: MatrixClientResolveOpts
classes.description: Options for resolving a Matrix client, including optional client, config, timeout, and account ID.

methods.name: isMatrixClient
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a MatrixClient instance.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixClientResolveOpts
methods.description: Normalizes input into a MatrixClientResolveOpts object.

methods.name: resolvePreviousEditContent
methods.description: Extracts the content of a previous edit event.

methods.name: hasMatrixMentionsMetadata
methods.description: Checks if content has Matrix mentions metadata.

methods.name: resolvePreviousEditMentions
methods.description: Resolves mentions from previous edit content.

methods.name: prepareMatrixSingleText
methods.description: Prepares a single chunk of text for Matrix, considering markdown and size limits.

methods.name: chunkMatrixText
methods.description: Splits text into chunks suitable for Matrix message size limits.

methods.name: sendMessageMatrix
methods.description: Sends a message or media to a Matrix room, handling chunking and media upload.

methods.name: sendPollMatrix
methods.description: Sends a poll to a Matrix room.

methods.name: sendTypingMatrix
methods.description: Sends a typing indicator to a Matrix room.

methods.name: sendReadReceiptMatrix
methods.description: Sends a read receipt for an event in a Matrix room.

methods.name: sendSingleTextMessageMatrix
methods.description: Sends a single text message to a Matrix room, ensuring it fits within size limits.

methods.name: getPreviousMatrixEvent
methods.description: Fetches a previous event from a Matrix room.

methods.name: editMessageMatrix
methods.description: Edits a previously sent Matrix message.

methods.name: reactMatrixMessage
methods.description: Adds a reaction emoji to a Matrix message.
